title: The Exciting match on Saturday
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：exciting　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exciting 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the operator wrote of ① an exciting match on Saturday in the log, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② more exciting than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the operator, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the exciting ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most exciting match on Saturday anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the log for June 1967 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too exciting to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainee who had come to help; the exciting ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an exciting news from the city, and said that no trainee in his right mind would call it ⑥ as exciting as the news from the city they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was exciting or not, and he said so.

By 1980 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something exciting, and nothing besides. The trainee from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite exciting; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the exciting ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1983, year after year, she wrote of another exciting match on Saturday in the same log, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ more exciting than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most exciting news from the city in the whole station, she said in 1985, was the one she could never quite name; the exciting ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 令人兴奋（前置定语 an exciting match on Saturday：1973 年操作员在运行日志里记下的那件令人兴奋的比赛）
B. adj. 令人兴奋／刺激（比较级 more exciting than：文中两处，一处比周六的比赛，一处比预想）
C. adj. 令人兴奋／刺激（最高级 the most exciting：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 令人兴奋（表语 too exciting to do：母亲觉得它太令人兴奋，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 刺激（前置定语 an exciting news from the city：叔叔把整件事称作一桩刺激的消息）
F. adj. 刺激（同级比较 as exciting as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩城里传来的消息相比）
G. adj. 刺激（后置定语 something exciting：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 刺激（受程度副词修饰 quite exciting：那位实习生的评价）

answers.why: exciting 意为“令人兴奋”，1973 年操作员在运行日志里记下的是“一件令人兴奋的比赛”，此处作前置定语 an exciting match on Saturday。
exciting 意为“令人兴奋”，此处用比较级 more exciting than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
exciting 意为“令人兴奋”，运行日志上 六月 那行字说它是机房里最令人兴奋的一件，故用最高级 the most exciting match on Saturday。
exciting 意为“令人兴奋”，母亲认为这件东西“太令人兴奋了，谁也用不上”，too exciting to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
exciting 意为“刺激”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩刺激的消息”，此处作前置定语 an exciting news from the city。
exciting 意为“刺激”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩城里传来的消息一样刺激”，同级比较用 as exciting as。
exciting 意为“刺激”，运行日志上那半行字要的是“刺激的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something exciting。
exciting 意为“刺激”，邻机房来的那位实习生认为这套计划“相当刺激”，quite 修饰原级 exciting。
exciting 意为“刺激”，1983 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要刺激”，故用比较级 more exciting than。
exciting 意为“刺激”，母亲 1985 年说的是“整个机房里最刺激的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most exciting news from the city。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，操作员在运行日志里记下了一件令人兴奋的比赛。（an exciting match on Saturday）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更令人兴奋。（more exciting than …）
母亲觉得它太令人兴奋，谁也用不上。（too exciting to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩刺激的消息。（an exciting news from the city）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩城里传来的消息一样刺激。（as exciting as …）
到了 1980 年，运行日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件刺激的东西。（something exciting）
answers: In 1973 the operator wrote of an exciting match on Saturday in the log.
Everybody said it was more exciting than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too exciting to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an exciting news from the city.
He said nobody would call it as exciting as the news from the city they had once had.
By 1980 the log asked for nothing but something exciting.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 exciting 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the operator wrote of an exciting match on Saturday in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most exciting match on Saturday in the station, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too exciting to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an exciting news from the city, and nobody argued with him.
The trainee from the next station called the plan quite exciting, and everybody laughed.
The exciting ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
